_how_to_use.1: Copy this file to devices/<codename>.json (lowercase codename, e.g. devices/a71.json). Do not edit _template.json itself.
_how_to_use.2: Fill every CHANGEME value from the real target/<codename>/config.sh in the upstream repo — copy firmware strings, partition sizes and DVFS filenames verbatim. Never invent them.
_how_to_use.3: Delete any field that does not apply to the device (e.g. extra_firmwares if TARGET_EXTRA_FIRMWARES is empty), rather than leaving a CHANGEME in it.
_how_to_use.4: Validate with: python3 -m json.tool devices/<codename>.json (must parse) and re-check every value against the upstream target/<codename>/ files. See devices/README.md for the modify-and-fix loop.
_how_to_use.5: Upstream for a new device is usually the closest sibling with the same SoC already in base or in a fork — for sm7150, use a71 (base) / m51 (forks) as the template.

assert_model: CHANGEME — e.g. SM-M515F — from TARGET_ASSERT_MODEL in config.sh, if present
base_firmware: CHANGEME — TARGET_FIRMWARE verbatim, format MODEL/CSC/<digits>, e.g. SM-M515F/BVO/357563172596302

base_upstream.note: CHANGEME — does base already have this codename, or only a fork? Which device was it modelled on?

blobs.note: List every vendored blob the target's patches/ directory actually ships. Do not list blobs from another device.
blobs.wpss_firmware: CHANGEME — only if the target has a patches/wpss/ directory; otherwise delete this key

bootloader.required: CHANGEME — bootloader version the assertions require, e.g. M515FXXS6DXE3

codename: CHANGEME — lowercase, e.g. m51. Must match the target/<codename>/ directory name exactly. buildenv.sh discovers targets by directory name.

csc.csc: CHANGEME — second field of TARGET_FIRMWARE, e.g. BVO
csc.note: CSC is the region/carrier code in the firmware string. A wrong CSC means the wrong stock firmware is downloaded and the build targets the wrong variant.

debloat.note: CHANGEME — summarise target/<codename>/debloat.sh, or delete this key if the target has no debloat.sh (e.g. base a52q has none).

extra_firmwares: CHANGEME — TARGET_EXTRA_FIRMWARES verbatim, or [] if empty
extra_firmwares_note: CHANGEME — if extra firmwares are declared, say whether you traced which blobs come from them. If not traced, say so explicitly. Do not assume.

fingerprint.note: CHANGEME — side / in-display optical / ultrasonic, and which patches/ entry handles it (e.g. sidefp smali patch), if any.

firmware_files.note: CHANGEME — are the modified firmware files in the UN1CA repo, or downloaded at build/install time? Give the repo/URL if external.
firmware_files.source: CHANGEME — target/<codename>/installer/customize.sh, if it downloads firmware

kernel.note: CHANGEME — is a kernel stored in the UN1CA repo, or downloaded at build time? Give the repo/URL and asset pattern if external.

os.file_system_type: CHANGEME — TARGET_OS_FILE_SYSTEM_TYPE if set, otherwise delete this key

overlay: CHANGEME — list the files under target/<codename>/overlay/, e.g. target/<codename>/overlay/values/strings.xml

patches.note: CHANGEME — list the directories under target/<codename>/patches/ for the branch you are using. Patch lists differ between branches — do not copy one branch's list onto another.

ril.note: CHANGEME — RIL blobs are device-specific. Do not reuse another device's RIL blobs.
vendor_files_required: CHANGEME — files under patches/ril/vendor/, e.g. vendor/bin/hw/rild

soc.name: CHANGEME — e.g. Qualcomm Snapdragon 730G
soc.note: CHANGEME — if config.sh has no TARGET_PLATFORM line, say so here and say how the SoC is identified instead (DVFS/SSRM filenames, debloat/sff headers). Do not invent a TARGET_PLATFORM value.

source_branch: CHANGEME — primary upstream branch, e.g. seventeen
source_firmware: CHANGEME — source firmware from unica/configs/qssi.sh (or essi.sh), format MODEL/CSC/<digits>, e.g. SM-S911B/INS/352404911234563
source_repo: CHANGEME — primary upstream repo, e.g. Arnav3078/UN1CA-SM7150

status.note: CHANGEME — set built/tested only after a real validate/build run. Until then, tested=false.
